fields.name: employee_id
fields.reason: Emp ID and staff_code columns both contain unique employee identifiers like EMP-20001

fields.name: first_name
fields.reason: First Name and fname columns provide the given name of each employee

fields.name: last_name
fields.reason: Last Name and lname columns provide the family name of each employee

fields.name: email
fields.reason: Email and email_id columns contain work email addresses, one per employee

fields.name: mobile_number
fields.reason: mobile column (present in two files) stores the employee's mobile phone number

fields.name: date_of_birth
fields.reason: DOB and birth_date columns both represent the employee's birth date

fields.name: date_of_joining
fields.reason: Date of Joining and joining_dt columns capture when the employee started

fields.name: department_code
fields.reason: Dept Code and department columns hold a short code for the employee's department

fields.name: job_title
fields.reason: Designation and grade columns describe the employee's role or grade

fields.name: employment_type
fields.reason: Employment Type and emp_type columns indicate full‑time vs contract status

fields.name: manager_id
fields.reason: Manager ID and reports_to columns reference the employee_id of the manager

fields.name: location
fields.reason: Location and site columns store the office/site code where the employee works

fields.name: status
fields.reason: Status and state columns both contain the employment status (e.g., ACTIVE)
